data.narrative:
Northwood Space, a Series B space and aerospace company founded by Bridgit Mendler and Griffin Cleverly, has raised $38M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 5 public-market Space & Aerospace peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private-sector equivalents, including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($38M) as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a typical Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x, yields $72M. Peer-median analysis across 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a $1.5B implied valuation; the peer set ranges from $1.1B (Skyryse) to $8.0B (Sierra Space), with a median of $1.5B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied: while the public Space & Aerospace sector trades at a 23.9x price-to-sales median across 6 tickers, Northwood's revenue is not disclosed.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $61M to $1.7B, with a median of $786M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty: the stage-progression method anchors to historical fundraising and assumes linear growth mechanics, while peer-median relies on heterogeneous comparables spanning multiple sub-stages and business models. Key uncertainties include Northwood's revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and whether peer valuations reflect durable capital efficiency or speculative pricing in an emerging sector.
